spans.t: A dark altar with skulls prominently on
display. A strange power can be felt in its
presence. Hanging from the side are some
valuable ornaments, but will they bring
you luck or not? Only time will tell...

spans.t: A dark altar with skulls prominently on display. A
strange power can be felt in its presence. To the
side, you find a pouch filled with coins, clearly
as a token to the departed. Feelings of guilt and
disgust wash over you as you pocket the money,
hoping not to have angered any malignant entity.

spans.t: A cart of human remains. It looks much like
a feeding trough. Disgusting. Yet it’s a great
reminder of your humanity. Searching it you
find some gold and provisions but alas, they’re
all contaminated. You put your gloves back on
but sadly the damage has already been done...

spans.t: An oddly assembled dining table. There might still
be food scraps around. You find a gold goblet,
used but valuable. It still has some stains and
as you check the residue on the bottom, you feel
yourself growing sick to your stomach. The liquid
splashes to your lips as you feel the sickness
spreading throughout your entire body.
3t

spans.t: A barrel that reeks of powerful liquors. It’s
cracked on the side and you see a handful
of gold and a trinket to the bottom of the
barrel. And then in horror you realize
that in the barrel, the moonshine has been
infused with the remains of a hapless soul.

spans.t: A barrel that reeks of powerful liquors. You
topple it to the side only to realize that it’s empty,
yet the rancid smell still lingers. A pouch filled
with coins jumps from the barrel’s side and when
you pick it up you realize that the moonshine
has been infused with the gastric fluids and
rotting bile of a hapless soul drowned in it.
3t

spans.t: Scrawlings written on what looks like stretched and
tanned human flesh. You read the passage in horror
only to realize it has been written by the hand of
a human. A feeling of hope fills your heart as your
humanity still lingers on. However, the image of
the letters burns brightly in your eyes, cauterizing
them in an arcane and mysterious fashion.
Occult Scrawlings

spans.t: Pile of Bones
All that’s left of a previous adventurer,
perhaps. You search the pile for anything
valuable, yet all you encounter is the
remnants of another human being,
contaminated and sharp enough for you to
cut and poison yourself in the process.
3t

spans.t: Pile of Bones
All that’s left of a previous adventurer,
perhaps. Underneath them, a small pack with
some untouched provisions. Yet you feel your
fever rising after coming in contact with them.
Praying that you didn’t catch something terminal
you rise to your feet and join your party.

spans.t: Pile of Scrolls
A bunch of scrolls. The cursive is sloppy
and difficult to read. You touch the sticky
parchment and read them idly only to find
their historical and scientific value. Later do
you realize that they have been coated with
a contact poison, a typical way to protect a
scholar’s work from thieving fingers...
3t

spans.t: Rack of Blades
A rack of sharp, rusty knives. They are
covered in fresh blood. A satchel is hanging
from one of the blades and as you unhinge
it, you realize it is filled with provisions.
However, the blade cuts you deeply as it
spreads its corrosive venom into your wound.
3t

spans.t: Rack of Blades
A rack of dulled, rusty knives. They are
covered in fresh blood. A satchel with a
trinket hangs from one of them and as you
unhinge it you feel some sticky goo from the
blade seep onto your skin. Soon enough it
begins to itch as a spreading rash appears.

spans.t: Sacrificial Stone
A stone used for ancient, barbaric rituals.
In its hollow base you discover a chest
with gold and a venomous spider that
rapidly injects you with its debilitating
poison. Your hand feels sore and your
head feels as if it’s about to burst.
